title: Kenyan Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan-inspired lamb stew recipe, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove lamb from pot, set aside.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add jewel, cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add lamb broth, stew spice blend, and tomato paste (if using).
Return lamb to pot, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
